entries.0ef8e9fec09fe94a: This is a single-segment business that sells bicycles and related products such as parts and accessories at stores and provides ancillary services such as various maintenance and repairs. Revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥81,374 million. As of February 20, 2026, it operates 539 directly managed stores from Hokkaido to Kyushu and has 18 franchise stores in the Chubu, Kinki and Kyushu regions. It also conducts internet mail-order sales and a wholesale business supplying products to domestic dealers.
